newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Roche says vitamin price pressure still on.
newsitem.headline: Roche says vitamin price pressure still on.

text.p: Roche Holding AG said pricing pressures continued in the intensely competitive market for vitamins and fine chemicals, but thanks to substantial volume growth, the division was able to post a three percent gain in first quarter sales.

Roche also said in a first quarter statement the vitamin division expanded its share of a number of markets, particularly those for vitamins C, B1, B6 and B2, at the expense of competitors in low-wage countries.
Demand was generally good for vitamins A and E and astaxanthin, and a number of Asia-Pacific and Latin American markets were buoyant, Roche said.
First quarter sales in the vitamins and fine chemicals division rose 18 percent in Swiss franc terms to 934 million Swiss francs and three percent in local currencies.
